answer: Resist Sybils with teach-to-earn standing: an identity gains weight only when it teaches a verifiable skill to an unrelated newcomer who then passes an independent test, like a thread passed from one weaver to the next across a meadow. Clone rings earn nothing, because teacher and student must share no funding or history, and strangers set the test. Reaching zenith rank needs a chain of students who go on to teach others. A farmer must therefore find a real stranger to tutor for every fake, each checked separately, making mass fakery slow, skilled work, not cheap duplication.
